messages.subject: M-array CJS model with 4 survival parameters
parts:
Hello,

I am attempting to fit a CJS model to capture-recapture data.  I am following the book "Integrated Populations Models" (Shaub & Kery 2021).

I am having a difficult time figuring out the correct likelihood for 4+ survival parameters.

I'm been generating simulated data and the estimates are close but I would think they would be better if the model was correct.  This is the likelihood that I've come up with: 

 # Above main diagonal
 #   for (j in (t+1):(nyears-1)){
      pi.1[t,j] <- p1[t] * prod(p2[(t+1):j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Juveniles to older age classes
      pi.2[t,j] <- prod(p2[t:j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Age class 2 to older
      pi.3[t,j] <- prod(p3[t:j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Age class 3 to older
     pi.4[t,j] <- prod(p4[t:j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Age class 4 to older
    }  # j

I don't think it's correct though -- Any help would be appreciated!  Thank you. 

The example from the book the successfully estimates two age classes is as follows:

# Above main diagonal
for (j in (t+1):(nyears-1)){
pi.j[t,j] <- phij[t] * prod(phia[(t+1):j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]
pi.a[t,j] <- prod(phia[t:j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]
} #j

messages.author: 312eda23f89ab6c6
messages.subject: AW: M-array CJS model with 4 survival parameters
parts:
Hi Trevor

 

Your code is incorrect because there is an age structure with only two age classes, and individuals released as 2 and 3 year olds no longer change survival as a function of age. To implement an age structure with 4 age classes, you should have something like this:

 

 # Above main diagonal
#   for (j in (t+1):(nyears-1)){

pi.1[t,j] <- p1[t] * p2[t+1] * p3[t+2] * prod(p4[(t+3):j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Juveniles to older age classes
      pi.2[t,j] <- p2[t] * p3[t+1] * prod(p4[(t+2):j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Age class 2 to older
      pi.3[t,j] <- p3[t] * prod(p4[(t+1):j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Age class 3 to older

pi.4[t,j] <- prod(p4[t:j]) * prod(q[t:(j-1)]) * p[j]  # Age class 4 to older
    }  # j

The time indices may not be quite right. And you need to put the four lines in different time loops so that only the m-array cells up to the last occasion are defined. Unfortunately I cannot find a code example at the moment, but I will send it when I find it.

 

Kind regards

 

Michael
